CITY OF CHEYENNE – PROPOSED AMENDMENT: Amendment No. 1 to the Agenda Item
No. 15 - "PLTA-26-5"



   e. Electricity. All data centers shall demonstrate access to adequate electricity
      capacity, pursuant to section 4.5.4 of this code. Any proposed facility on or near a
      data center campus proposed to provide continual on-site power shall comply with
      all applicable state and federal requirements, including those of the Wyoming Public
      Service Commission and the Wyoming Industrial Siting Council where applicable.
   f. Natural Gas. If any large-scale natural gas facility is proposed on a data center site,
      that facility shall demonstrate access to adequate natural gas capacity, pursuant to
      section 4.5.4 of this code.
   g. Construction Activities. All data center construction activities shall meet the
      requirements of section 5.8.9 of this code.
   h. Lighting. All properties shall meet the lighting requirements of UDC 6.4 (or section
      5.8.9 of this code when under construction).
   i. Public Records. Records relating to data center development are subject to the
      public records provisions of section 1.1.8 of this code.
   j. Building and Fire Safety. Data centers shall be designed, constructed, installed, and
      maintained in accordance with all applicable building and fire codes. The
      requirements of this subsection are adopted as site-plan and land-use design and
      submittal standards and, where applicable, pursuant to the City's local enforcement
      authority under Wyo. Stat. § 35-9-121. All sites shall meet the following
      requirements:
          1. Compliance with NFPA 75, Standard for the Fire Protection of Information
              Technology Equipment, current edition.
          2. Compliance with Battery Energy Storage Systems; NFPA 855, Standard for
              the Installation of Stationary Energy Storage Systems and International Fire
              Code Occupancy Group H.
          3. Provision of a Fire Protection Engineering Risk Assessment: a fire and life
              safety risk assessment for high-density server areas, specialized cooling
              systems (including refrigerants and liquid or immersion cooling fluids), and
              emergency or standby generators shall be submitted to the City.
          4. Provision of an Interior Fire Protection Mapping: a digital interior map or
              three- dimensional model of the facility identifying all fire protection and life
              safety features shall be submitted to the City. The map or model shall be
              provided at no cost to the City and shall be updated within thirty (30) days
